claude.sample_unit: published TCM medical record cases of MAFLD

links.outcome: TCM syndrome differentiation and overall answer quality with vs without knowledge base grounding
links.effect: ChatGLM4+Knowledge Base ranked first in comprehensive score (488.93) vs ChatGLM4 (429.16), ChatGPT-4.0 (409.23), and ChatGLM3-6B (396.93); syndrome-differentiation module also top.
links.quote: The results showed that ChatGLM4+ Knowledge Base ranked first with a total score of 488.93 points, significantly outperforming the other models.

links.outcome: Conceptual confusion between TCM and Western medicine terminology in LLM outputs
links.effect: ChatGPT-4.0 exhibited concept confusion in 32 of 87 cases; ChatGLM3-6B had 1 case; ChatGLM4 and ChatGLM4+Knowledge Base had zero.
links.quote: In the evaluation of confusion of concepts between TCM and Western medicine, ChatGPT-4.0 exhibited concept confusion in 32 out of 87 cases (see Table S1 in Multimedia Appendix 1 ).

links.outcome: Agreement with expert TCM syndrome differentiation and treatment principles
links.effect: Agreement with experts ranged 49.14%-56.50% for syndrome differentiation and 53.35%-62.13% for treatment principles across models.
links.quote: The agreement percentage of treatment principles in descending order was ChatGLM4+ knowledgebase>ChatGLM4>ChatGPT-4.0>ChatGLM3-6B (see Table 1 ).

unlisted_practices: Combining domain knowledge base with real-time internet search for TCM LLM
Domain- and culture-specific fine-tuning of general-purpose LLMs

links.effect: Total score: ChatGLM4+KB 488.93; ChatGLM4 429.16; ChatGPT-4.0 409.23; ChatGLM3-6B 396.93.
links.quote: The results showed that ChatGLM4+ Knowledge Base (combining internet search capabilities with knowledge base pretraining) ranked first in total score, significantly outperforming ChatGLM4 and ChatGPT-4.0, which relied solely on internet search capabilities.

links.effect: ChatGPT-4.0 confused concepts in 32/87 cases; ChatGLM3-6B had 1; ChatGLM4 and ChatGLM4+KB had 0.
links.quote: Regarding the assessment of confusion between TCM and Western medicine concepts, ChatGPT-4.0 exhibited conceptual confusion in 32 out of 87 cases, while the ChatGLM series of LLMs showed no such confusion (except for ChatGLM3-6B, which had 1 instance).

unlisted_practices: Assess whether TCM LLM recommendations include self-positioning as an auxiliary tool rather than replacing physicians.
Screen TCM LLM treatment recommendations for toxic Chinese medicine ingredients.
Evaluate conceptual confusion between traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine terminology.

links.outcome: TCM diagnostic and therapeutic accuracy and response quality
links.effect: ChatGLM4+Knowledge Base outperformed ungrounded ChatGLM4 in syndrome differentiation agreement (56.12% vs 52.33%), treatment principles agreement (62.13% vs 54.24%), and total score (488.93 vs 429.16).
links.quote: The results showed that ChatGLM4+ Knowledge Base (combining internet search capabilities with knowledge base pretraining) ranked first in total score, significantly outperforming ChatGLM4 and ChatGPT-4.0, which relied solely on internet search capabilities.

unlisted_practices: Real-time internet search connectivity for clinical large language models

screen.reason: The study directly compares variants of LLMs with and without a knowledge base (retrieval-grounding) and internet connectivity across 87 clinical case records to evaluate performance and safety in TCM treatment plans.
